level_formula_check: Tapu Bulu/Bellossom/Oricorio offset 1 -> L83, Mudsdale offset 2 -> L84. Confirmed.

attempts.narrative: T1 Fake Out Bulu + Heat Wave OHKO Bulu; Bellossom Protected. T2 I deliberately gave the troupe a turn (Chi-Yu Protect, Knock Off Oricorio 198) to observe the engine: Bellossom Quiver Dance, Oricorio Dancer-copied it and then used its own for +2. T3 Oricorio +2 Revelation Dance OHKO Incineroar (332); Bellossom Petal Dance went to the slot I had just switched Swampert into (4x) and Dancer copied Petal Dance into it too: two faints in one turn. T4 Sucker Punch KO Oricorio, Heat Wave missed Bellossom, Petal Dance KO Chien-Pao. T5 Bellossom Protect blocked Shadow Ball + Heat Wave, Mudsdale Heavy Slam OHKO Flutter Mane. T6 Surging Strikes KO Mudsdale, +1 Giga Drain KO Urshifu. T7-8 Chi-Yu 1v1: Heat Wave into Sash, Bellossom Quiver Danced at 1 HP, Heat Wave finished. Chi-Yu ended at 44/213.

ai_observations: T7 Bellossom at 1 HP chose Quiver Dance over Giga Drain against a 184 HP Chi-Yu; not lethal either way, and it died next turn. Not a defect.
level_change_rationale: Won on attempt 1 but with 5 faints and Chi-Yu at 44 HP: a real fight -> keep. Caveat: two of the five faints came from a turn I deliberately gave the troupe to observe Dancer; a player who Fake Outs Bellossom and Heat Waves turn 1 (the crack line) finishes this in three turns. The current levels are right for the puzzle-6 slot.
could_this_be_cooler: It already is: the Dancer copy landed twice and one +2 Oricorio turned a 6-4 board into a 4-4 board. The one thing that undercuts the concept is the lead: Bulu + Bellossom means Oricorio is never on the field for the opening dance the plan describes, and a Fire lead deletes Bulu before the stage matters. Leading Bellossom + Oricorio (Bulu as the reserve that re-sets terrain) would make the plan's 'one turn buys two boosted attackers' true on turn 1. Not changed in this pass.
